title: Settlement Operations Manual: Deduction, Remittance and Shortfall Timetable for the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
The settlement timetable of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement fixes, per program tier, when deduction files are delivered, when deducted amounts are remitted and how shortfalls are reported, contested and cured.

| | Starter | Growth | Professional | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business days before a pay date on which its deduction file is delivered to the employer | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Business days after the pay date by which deducted amounts must be remitted | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Remittance methods the employer may use | ACH debit authorization | ACH debit authorization | ACH debit authorization; employer ACH credit | ACH debit authorization; employer ACH credit; wire | ACH debit authorization; employer ACH credit; wire | ACH debit authorization; employer ACH credit; wire |
| Fee billed when an ACH debit of a remittance is returned unpaid (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 |
| Business days after the pay date by which the employer reports the reason for each unremitted deduction | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Business days after a shortfall is classified employer-liable within which the employer may contest it with payroll evidence | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 15 |
| Business days after classification within which an employer-liable shortfall must be remitted | 5 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Who bears a reported shortfall

The same liability map applies on every tier:

| Reported shortfall reason | Borne by |
|---|---|
| Net pay insufficient to cover the deduction | absorbed by Paystride (provider-absorbed) |
| Employment ended | absorbed by Paystride (provider-absorbed) |
| Payroll processing error | the employer (employer-liable) |
| Deduction not taken | the employer (employer-liable) |
| Deducted but not remitted | the employer (employer-liable) |

Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays.
